verdict: harness accepted; variance criterion NOT met yet
notes: 27 runs, gpt-4o-mini T=0, seed 20260916, 6-8 cases per corpus. Exact-substring scoring was a ruler defect (full-history 0.38 on support) — replaced by key-word matching and rescored offline. Two real Mengram defects surfaced by the context capture on companion/L: (1) facts the user states about themselves were attributed to the entity 'User's sister' after one sentence about the sister, so the answer model correctly said 'unknown' though the value was retrieved; (2) five paraphrases of one intention stored as five facts ('intends/plans/wants/needs to call the plumber'). Repeat of the same config moved recall@old 0.25->0.50: extraction is nondeterministic, so the pre-registered <5% variance is not met by a single run; report mean and spread over 3 repeats from now on. Sandbox baseline collapses at M/L on companion and coding as its code predicts.

verdict: recall clause met, junk clause missed by 0.02
notes: Fix: cloud/store/_naming.py looks_like_someone_else + _find_primary_person skips relative-shaped candidates (2.44.8). companion/L mean recall@old 0.25-0.50 -> 0.83 (>= 0.75 pre-registered). Junk clause 'not worse than 0.50' missed: mean 0.52 (two runs 0.50, one 0.57); attribution fix does not touch paraphrase duplication, which is the whole junk. L still loses ~1 of 8 old facts per run: retrieved_rate equals recall, so the miss is retrieval/extraction, not the answer model. Spread 0.12-0.17 over 3 repeats is the noise floor of gpt-4o-mini extraction; any future claim below that is not a result. Paraphrase/junk goes to E1.
